title: Genetic location of primocane-fruiting discovered in blackberries - EurekAlert!
summary: The genetic region controlling the primocane-fruiting trait in blackberries, or the ability to flower and fruit on first-year canes, remained uncertain recently even though the trait has fueled the rapid growth of the fresh-market blackberry industry. Published in the journal Genetics, a study explains how genome-wide association identified a single genomic region on chromosome Ra03 that is strong associated with the trait. The team also designed two DNA markers that reliably predict whether a blackberry plant will express primocane fruiting. The new research can speed development of improved varieties with better yield, fruit quality and regional adaptability.
